sections.description:
RankBotAI writes the SEO you never get around to writing.

Rank Math and Yoast tell you what is missing. RankBotAI fills it in — meta titles, meta descriptions and focus keywords, generated by AI in your content’s own language and written straight back into the SEO plugin you already use.

Point it at 5 posts or 5,000 products, walk away, and come back to a site with complete, non-duplicate SEO data. Every change is backed up first, so a single click puts everything back.

What you get in the first 10 minutes

  1. Connect your site (free account, free monthly credits — no credit card).
  2. Open Bulk Optimization, filter to “posts with no focus keyword”.
  3. Press start. Background processing does the rest — roughly 700 items/hour.
  4. Check the History log. Don’t like something? Restore that one item, that one content type, or the whole site.

Why site owners switch to it

  • It scales the part that does not scale. A WooCommerce catalog with 3,000 products is a month of freelancer work. Here it is an afternoon of background cron.
  • It never leaves you stuck. Snapshots are taken before every change, and Restore works per item, per content type, or site-wide.
  • It respects your SEO plugin. Values are written into Rank Math / Yoast / AIOSEO fields — no lock-in, no shadow database, nothing breaks if you deactivate RankBotAI.
  • It writes in your language. The AI detects the source language of each post or product and answers in it — Ukrainian content stays Ukrainian.
  • It does not hallucinate your catalog. Strict anti-hallucination rules: no invented prices, no competitor brands, no [placeholder] text, facts from your content only.

Built for AI search, not just Google

Search is moving into ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews. RankBotAI ships an llms.txt generator so AI crawlers get a clean, structured map of what your site is about — plus Schema.org JSON-LD for Article and WooCommerce Product data.

AI vs. manual SEO — speed

  • Optimize 1 product page — SEO specialist: 15–30 min vs. RankBotAI: ~10 sec
  • Research & set focus keywords (100 pages) — SEO specialist: 2–3 days vs. RankBotAI: ~20 min
  • Write meta titles & descriptions (100 pages) — SEO specialist: 1–2 days vs. RankBotAI: ~15 min
  • Full SEO audit + optimization (500 pages) — SEO specialist: 2–4 weeks vs. RankBotAI: ~2 hours
  • Bulk optimize an entire WooCommerce catalog — SEO specialist: weeks/months vs. RankBotAI: hours
  • Availability — SEO specialist: business hours vs. RankBotAI: 24/7/365

Cost comparison

  • Monthly cost (100 pages/mo) — Freelance SEO: $500–$2,000 · Agency: $2,000–$10,000 · RankBotAI: from $0 (free tier)
  • Per-page optimization — Freelance SEO: $5–$20 · Agency: $10–$50 · RankBotAI: ~$0.01–$0.15
  • Speed to results — Freelance SEO: days–weeks · Agency: weeks · RankBotAI: minutes
  • Works 24/7 — Freelance SEO: no · Agency: no · RankBotAI: yes
  • Consistent quality — Freelance SEO: varies · Agency: varies · RankBotAI: always consistent

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Meta Generation — Automatically generate optimized SEO titles, meta descriptions, and focus keywords
  • Smart Focus Keyword Research — AI analyzes your content and suggests the best focus keyword, avoiding keywords already used elsewhere on the site
  • Bulk Optimization — Process hundreds or thousands of pages in the background via WP-Cron, with live progress, speed and ETA
  • Taxonomy Optimization — Optimize categories, tags and any custom taxonomy term (single & bulk)
  • Backup & Restore — Snapshots before every change; restore a single item, one content type, or the whole site
  • 100-Point SEO Scoring — Real-time SEO analysis with actionable recommendations
  • Rank Math & Yoast Integration — Reads and writes SEO fields for Rank Math, Yoast SEO, and AIOSEO
  • WooCommerce Ready — Products, product categories and attributes, with a dedicated “RankBot AI” tab in Product Data
  • Content Optimization — AI can improve your post/product content for better SEO (opt-in)
  • Global Instructions for AI — Site-wide rules injected into every generation (“never mention free shipping”, “always add this disclaimer”)
  • Local-First History — History is mirrored to a local table and read locally first, keeping dashboards instant even on 40,000+ item sites
  • llms.txt Generator — Publish a structured site map for AI search engines
  • Schema.org JSON-LD — Article and enhanced WooCommerce Product structured data
  • A/B Testing — Rotate two meta title/description variants and track impressions
  • CSV Export / Import — Bulk edit SEO data outside WordPress and import it back
  • SEO Checklist & Gutenberg Sidebar — Score, checklist and one-click optimization inside the block editor
  • Dashboard Widget & Admin Bar — SEO health overview and live job monitoring
  • Free Credits & Referrals — Earn credits by inviting friends, sharing, or reviewing
  • Advanced AI Engine — Multi-model system with automatic failover; nothing to configure

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Connect your site to the RankBotAI service (free account)
  3. Start optimizing — click “Auto Optimize” on any post, or launch bulk processing
  4. AI generates optimized SEO data and applies it to your content
  5. Your SEO fields in Rank Math / Yoast are updated automatically

Works Great With

  • Rank Math SEO — Full integration: reads/writes focus keywords, meta titles, and descriptions
  • Yoast SEO — Full integration: reads/writes focus keywords, meta titles, and descriptions
  • All in One SEO (AIOSEO) — Basic integration for meta fields
  • WooCommerce — Optimized for products with enhanced Product JSON-LD schema
  • WPML & Polylang — Per-post language detection for multilingual sites
  • Works standalone — If no SEO plugin is installed, RankBotAI stores data in its own meta fields

Languages

The admin interface is fully translated into English, Ukrainian and Russian. German, Spanish and Polish translations are partial and being completed — contributions are welcome.

Compatibility

RankBotAI is designed to work alongside other SEO plugins.

It can read/write common SEO fields used by:
* Yoast SEO
* Rank Math
* All in One SEO

Notes:
* RankBotAI does not disable other SEO plugins.
* If multiple plugins manage the same meta fields, the “last saved” value wins (standard WordPress behavior).
* When Rank Math, Yoast or AIOSEO is active, RankBotAI extends their structured data instead of emitting a second, duplicate JSON-LD block.
* For best results, we recommend having either Rank Math or Yoast SEO active.
* Tested with WordPress 7.1, including the iframed post editor and the persistent editor toolbar.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API service (RankBotAI) to generate SEO suggestions and optimizations.

Service provider:
* RankBotAI: https://rankbotai.link
* BuyReadySite (support/maintenance): https://buyreadysite.com

Service policies:
* Privacy Policy: https://rankbotai.link/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://rankbotai.link/terms

API base URL used by the plugin:
* https://rankbotai.link

The plugin sends requests to the service when you:
* Connect your site (registration/verification)
* Request generation/optimization (for posts, products, and terms)
* View your RankBot history/balance/models/plans (service data)
* Poll background jobs (queued optimizations)

Data sent to the service can include (depending on the action you trigger):
* Your site URL (domain) and basic environment info (WordPress version, plugin version)
* A site connection key (Bearer token) stored in your WordPress database
* Post/product/term data you choose to optimize, such as title, permalink, excerpt, and content (including HTML)
* Existing focus keyword (if present), categories/tags, and basic WooCommerce product attributes (e.g. price, currency, SKU)
* Image IDs/context for generating alt text (if enabled by the optimization action)

Endpoints used by the plugin include:
* POST /api/v1/site/register
* POST /api/v1/site/verify
* GET /api/v1/balance
* GET /api/v1/plans
* GET /api/v1/models
* GET /api/v1/history
* POST /api/v1/generate
* POST /api/v1/jobs/check
* POST /api/v1/internal/run-job
* GET /api/v1/referral
* POST /api/v1/bonus/claim
* GET /api/v1/site/custom-prompt
* POST /api/v1/site/custom-prompt

No data is sent to any other third party. The plugin loads no external fonts, scripts or stylesheets — every asset is served from your own site.

Please review the RankBotAI website for service terms and privacy information:
* https://rankbotai.link/privacy
* https://rankbotai.link/terms

Pricing / Tokens

RankBotAI uses a credit-based system.

  • A free tier is available with monthly free credits and full access to the RankBot AI engine.
  • Paid subscriptions provide higher credit limits and priority processing.
  • Pay As You Go option available — top up credits as needed. Credits from packs never expire.
  • Billing and plan management happens on the service website (not inside WordPress).

Data Storage

The plugin stores:
* A site connection key in WordPress options (used to authenticate API requests)
* Optimization history and SEO score data in post/term meta
* Background job tracking data in custom database tables (wp_rankbot_jobs, wp_rankbot_bulk_queue, wp_rankbot_local_history)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. (Recommended) Install and activate Rank Math SEO or Yoast SEO for the best experience.
  4. Go to the RankBotAI menu in wp-admin and connect your site.
  5. Start optimizing your content!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects to the RankBotAI service API to generate SEO suggestions and optimizations. A free tier with monthly free credits is available, and no credit card is required to start.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free and GPL-licensed. The RankBotAI service provides a free credit tier and offers paid plans for additional usage and higher limits.

Does RankBotAI work with Yoast SEO / Rank Math?

Yes! RankBotAI is specifically designed to complement Rank Math and Yoast SEO. It reads existing SEO data from these plugins and writes optimized values back into their own fields — so your SEO data stays exactly where it was, and nothing is lost if you deactivate RankBotAI.

Can I use RankBotAI without Rank Math or Yoast?

Yes. RankBotAI works standalone and stores SEO data in its own meta fields. However, for the best SEO results, we recommend pairing it with Rank Math or Yoast SEO.

Will it overwrite meta titles and descriptions I wrote myself?

Only the items you select. Bulk Optimization has filters such as “only items without a focus keyword” and “only unprocessed items”, so you can target the gaps and leave your hand-written work untouched. And every change is snapshotted before it is applied.

Can I undo the changes?

Yes — that is the point of the Backups & Restore page. You can roll back a single post or product from the History log, roll back one content type, or roll back the entire site to its pre-RankBot state.

Does it work with WooCommerce products?

Yes. Products, product categories and product attributes are supported, including a dedicated “RankBot AI” tab inside the Product Data box. Bulk optimization of a full catalog is the most common use case.

Can it optimize categories and tags?

Yes. Any public taxonomy term — categories, tags, product categories, custom taxonomies — can be optimized individually or in bulk, with the same backup and restore guarantees.

What language will the generated text be in?

The same language as the source content. The AI detects the language of each post or product and writes in it. WPML and Polylang sites are detected per post.

Can I tell the AI what it must never write?

Yes. Global Instructions (Settings) let you set site-wide rules that are injected into every generation — for example “never promise free shipping”, “always mention that packaging may vary”, or “describe only the product in the title”.

How fast is the optimization?

Most single-page optimizations complete in 5–15 seconds. Bulk optimization runs in the background at roughly 700 items/hour on a healthy connection, so 100+ pages typically finish within 15–30 minutes.

Does it slow down my site for visitors?

No. All AI processing happens on the RankBotAI service and in background WP-Cron jobs in wp-admin. On the frontend the plugin only outputs meta tags and JSON-LD structured data.

What data does the plugin send to the API?

It sends only the data needed for the action you trigger. This can include your site URL, environment info (WordPress/plugin version), and the post/product/term content you request to optimize.

What AI models are available?

RankBotAI uses its own RankBot AI engine — an advanced multi-model system with automatic failover. You don’t need to choose or configure any models. The system automatically selects the best available model for each request.

Does RankBotAI modify my content?

Only if you explicitly enable content optimization in settings. By default, RankBotAI only updates SEO meta fields (title, description, focus keyword). Content changes require opt-in.

What is llms.txt and why should I care?

llms.txt is a plain-text map of your site aimed at AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews). It helps them understand and cite your pages correctly. RankBotAI generates and manages it for you.

2.0.1 — 2026-08-16

  • COMPAT: Tested with WordPress 7.1. The block-editor sidebar, classic-editor toolbar and admin-bar widget were reviewed against the 7.1 iframed editor, persistent editor toolbar and updated editor components — no changes required. The plugin uses no jQuery UI, so the jQuery UI 1.14.2 update does not affect it.
  • COMPAT: Minimum WordPress version raised to 6.2. The plugin uses %i table-identifier placeholders in $wpdb->prepare(), which were introduced in WordPress 6.2 — on older versions those queries silently returned nothing.
  • FIX: Fatal error on PHP 7.4. The plugin declared PHP 7.4 support but called the PHP 8 functions str_contains() / str_starts_with(), which crashed the site with “Call to undefined function”. Polyfills added.
  • FIX: Duplicate structured data. RankBotAI emitted its own Article/Product JSON-LD block even when Rank Math, Yoast or AIOSEO already output a full schema graph, causing “Duplicate field” warnings in Search Console. It now extends the active SEO plugin’s schema instead, and a rankbot_ai_force_schema_output filter is available to restore the old behaviour.
  • SECURITY: Hardened the JSON-LD output — a title or meta description containing </script> could break out of the structured-data block and inject markup into the page head.
  • SECURITY: The site-connection callback now requires a one-time state value generated by this site, so an activation link crafted by someone else can no longer silently re-bind the site to another RankBotAI account.
  • FIX: A/B testing — the sticky-variant cookie was set from wp_head, i.e. after headers were already sent, so it was never actually stored and visitors were re-randomised on every pageview. The variant is now resolved on template_redirect.
  • FIX: A/B testing no longer prints a second <meta name="description"> next to Rank Math / Yoast. With an SEO plugin active, the variant is applied through that plugin’s own description filter, so the test actually takes effect.
  • PRIVACY: Removed the Inter / JetBrains Mono webfont request to fonts.googleapis.com. No admin IP addresses are shared with Google any more, and wp-admin loads one render-blocking request less. The UI falls back to the system font stack that the rest of the plugin already used.
  • IMPROVED: API request bodies are encoded with wp_json_encode(), which sanity-checks UTF-8 — content with broken encoding no longer produces an empty request body.
  • IMPROVED: Random variant selection uses wp_rand().
  • DOCS: Readme rewritten — clearer positioning, expanded FAQ, and an honest statement of translation coverage (English/Ukrainian/Russian complete; German/Spanish/Polish partial).

The following fixes were rolled out on the RankBotAI service on 2026-07-31 and reached every site without a plugin update. They are listed here for the record:

  • SERVICE: Optimization no longer stalls on non-automotive catalogs. A validator rule that rejected wording like “universal”, “fits any car” or “leather care” was written for auto-parts stores but was being applied to every product. On clothing, cookware or cosmetics — where “universal size” is perfectly normal copy — it rejected good output until the job hit max retries and was abandoned. The rule is now scoped to automotive context, and other niches get their own “use only the facts in the title, description and attributes” guidance.
  • SERVICE: Top-ups fixed. Accounts whose payments / user_subscriptions tables predated the gateway and billing-period columns could not pay at all — every top-up failed with “Unknown column ‘billing_period'”. The missing columns are now migrated automatically.
  • SERVICE: Paid models are no longer pushed into the shared dead-model cache after a transient provider error. That was the root cause of runs failing with “all free models exhausted” while the paid fallback sat disabled.
  • SERVICE: Replaced the retired gemini-2.0-flash-001 model — the provider had started answering 404 “no endpoints” — with gemini-2.5-flash.

2.0.0 — 2026-06-15

  • NEW: Complete “Sunset Premium” v2.0 admin redesign — Dashboard, Bulk Processing, Onboarding, Settings, History, Restore and llms.txt rebuilt on a new design system (sunset gradient, Inter + JetBrains Mono, smooth animations, glow & particle effects).

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API service (RankBotAI) to generate SEO suggestions and optimizations.

Service provider:
* RankBotAI: https://rankbotai.link
* BuyReadySite (support/maintenance): https://buyreadysite.com

Service policies:
* Privacy Policy: https://rankbotai.link/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://rankbotai.link/terms

API base URL used by the plugin:
* https://rankbotai.link

The plugin sends requests to the service when you:
* Connect your site (registration/verification)
* Request generation/optimization (for posts, products, and terms)
* View your RankBot history/balance/models/plans (service data)
* Poll background jobs (queued optimizations)

Data sent to the service can include (depending on the action you trigger):
* Your site URL (domain) and basic environment info (WordPress version, plugin version)
* A site connection key (Bearer token) stored in your WordPress database
* Post/product/term data you choose to optimize, such as title, permalink, excerpt, and content (including HTML)
* Existing focus keyword (if present), categories/tags, and basic WooCommerce product attributes (e.g. price, currency, SKU)
* Image IDs/context for generating alt text (if enabled by the optimization action)

Endpoints used by the plugin include:
* POST /api/v1/site/register
* POST /api/v1/site/verify
* GET /api/v1/balance
* GET /api/v1/plans
* GET /api/v1/models
* GET /api/v1/history
* POST /api/v1/generate
* POST /api/v1/jobs/check
* POST /api/v1/internal/run-job
* GET /api/v1/referral
* POST /api/v1/bonus/claim
* GET /api/v1/site/custom-prompt
* POST /api/v1/site/custom-prompt

No data is sent to any other third party. The plugin loads no external fonts, scripts or stylesheets — every asset is served from your own site.

Please review the RankBotAI website for service terms and privacy information:
* https://rankbotai.link/privacy
* https://rankbotai.link/terms
